# kkp_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key stored in a project. Assign it to clusters with `kkp_cluster.ssh_key_ids`; KKP's user SSH key agent then puts it on every node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kkp_ssh_key" "ops" {
  name       = "ops"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, unique within the project.
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH authorized_keys format.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `creation_timestamp` (String)
- `fingerprint` (String) MD5 fingerprint, as KKP shows it.
- `id` (String) Key ID, generated by KKP.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import kkp_ssh_key.ops <project_id>/<key_id>
```
